strategy_roster.name: RRS Impulse
strategy_roster.notes: The default Rsi mode in Trend direction trades the oscillator leaving oversold for longs and overbought for shorts, so the RSI zone exits are the long translation. The Stochastic/Bollinger modes, multi-timeframe signal-strength ladder and pip-based protective exits are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: VarMovAvg
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close, 10) and low < ema(close, 10) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: The adaptive Variable Moving Average is approximated by EMA(10); Bar A is the dip into that average inside a rising VMA and Bar B the bullish reclaim that triggers the long. The pip-scaled Bar A/B distances, entry tolerance and the moving-average trailing stop are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: BladeRunner
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high, 5) and ema(close, 6) > ema(close, 85) and roc(close, 14) > 0.3
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fractal breakout is approximated by a fresh five-bar high, with the documented fast/slow LWMA 6/85 and Momentum 14 threshold 0.3 retained. The 200-bar fractal lookback, separate momentum and MACD candle feeds, scaling and price-step stops/targets are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Harami CCI Confirmation
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close, open) and (close - open) < 0.5 * (high - low) and close > ema(close, 20)
strategy_roster.notes: crossabove(close, open) encodes the two-candle harami turn (previous candle not bullish, current candle bullish) and the body-versus-range test keeps the small-body confirmation; CCI is replaced by the body-size moving average since CCI is not in the DSL. Body Average and CCI periods have no documented values.

strategy_roster.name: Long-Leg Doji Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high, 1) and high - low > 0.5 * atr(high, low, close, 14)
strategy_roster.notes: The doji high is approximated by the prior bar high so the long breakout is a fresh one-bar high, and the documented ATR filter (ATR 14, multiplier 0.5) becomes a volatility-expansion test. Docs state no stops, and the exit is the documented SMA(20) cross.

strategy_roster.name: KPrmSt Cross
strategy_roster.notes: KPrmSt is approximated by a bounded oscillator (RSI) whose main line crosses its smoothed signal line downward to open the documented long. K/D/slowing periods have no documented values (5/3) and the price-unit stop and target cannot be expressed as percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Fraus M1
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is not in the DSL, so the documented WilliamsPeriod 360 oscillator is approximated by the close's position inside the 360-bar range: long in the bottom tenth, exit back at the range mid-point. The 50/150 pip stop and target are pip values, not percentages, and the session filter is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Martingale with MACD and KDJ
strategy_roster.notes: The documented dual condition (MACD line and the oscillator main line crossing their signal lines together) keeps MACD 12/26/9 and substitutes RSI(9)/SMA(3) for KDJ %K/%D, whose periods are not documented. Martingale pyramiding, percent add/rebound levels and pip exits are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Auto Fibonacci and Gann Fan Retracements Combo
strategy_roster.notes: The documentation states the levels are written to the log and that no trading logic is executed, so there is no market-derived signal to translate. A never-true guard is used rather than inventing entries from swing points.

strategy_roster.name: R&D Expenditures
strategy_roster.notes: This is a cross-sectional monthly quintile strategy ranked on R&D expense to market cap, requiring fundamental data and multi-name ranking that a single-symbol DSL cannot express. A never-true guard prevents fabricating a price signal.
